## Workflow Analysis
This document outlines continuous physical variable transformations passing directly into Piecewise Exponential Additive Models (`pammtools`) and complex design-weighted tensor smoother survival loops (`mgcv::gam`).

```{r simulation_run, message=FALSE}
library(survey)
library(dplyr)
library(mgcv)
library(pammtools)

set.seed(42)
n_obs <- 200
meps_raw <- tibble(
  id = 1:n_obs,
Use code with caution.
year = sample(2018:2021, n_obs, replace = TRUE),
sex = sample(c(0, 1), n_obs, replace = TRUE),
age = sample(18:85, n_obs, replace = TRUE),
reported_wt = rnorm(n_obs, mean = 175, sd = 35),
reported_ht = rnorm(n_obs, mean = 66, sd = 4),
time_to_event = runif(n_obs, 0.1, 5.0),
mortality_status = sample(c(0, 1), n_obs, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.92, 0.08)),
VARSTR = sample(1001:1010, n_obs, replace = TRUE),
VARPSU = sample(1:2, n_obs, replace = TRUE),
SAQWT24F = runif(n_obs, 500, 15000)
)
meps_design <- svydesign(ids = ~VARPSU, strata = ~VARSTR, weights = ~SAQWT24F, nest = TRUE, data = meps_raw)
meps_ped <- as_ped(data = meps_design$variables, formula = Surv(time_to_event, mortality_status) ~ reported_ht + reported_wt + age + sex, id = "id")
pamm_fit <- gam(ped_status ~ s(tend) + te(reported_ht, reported_wt) + sex, family = poisson(link = "log"), data = meps_ped, weights = meps_ped$SAQWT24F)
summary(pamm_fit)
```
